name: FACTORY
summary: Turn an intent into a staffed OpenRig build: choose the rig, host and workflow as diagrams, then launch the work on real rails.

surface.hint: intent → plan → pick the machine → build

_drive_note: Uses the SDK drive and focus primitives directly. Ops carry Factory intent: {intent:{title,intent,plan}, select:{rig,host,workflow}, preview:true, kickoff:{...options}, proof:{approve|approveAll}, say}. Runtime-owned /api/drive and /api/focus do not belong in calls{} because no provider answers them. window.factory remains the same richer page-handle API.
